headline: Peru Congress Approves $2.4 Billion Supplementary Credit for Public Works
summary: Peru's Congress approved a $2.4 billion supplementary credit for El Niño preparation, public works, and services, while authorizing $1.28 billion in bonds.
why: Supplementary fiscal spending and bond authorizations alter Peru's fiscal deficit targets and sovereign debt issuance schedules.

impacts.name: Peru
impacts.why: Supplementary budget approval increases government expenditure and bond issuance.
